text:
emma.partners: Quick sync: need a concise ship-and-handoff plan for H100/H200, MI300, and Gaudi wave. Target: single owner table + embargo windows + fallback mapping for marketplace and SI.

dmitri-hw: I can take HW validation items (firmware hash, kernel tag, thermal log). Habana warned of a microcode drop late-June.

claire.prod: Marketplace needs: tile JSON, pricing slug, supported instance list, and a customer-facing fallback blurb. Legal requires exact embargo start/end dates.

rick-devex: Devex will prepare quickstarts, an IaC snippet for device mounts, and a minimal CI smoke. Example smoke: ./ci_smoke --model llama2-13b --seq 2048 --bs 1 --target-p50 130

zara-oncall: Ops: recommend routing policy pseudocode: if cap(mi300_region)<0.2 -> route to [h200_fallback,b200_fallback]; else if p50_delta>0.25 -> route to gaudi_degraded. Need SRE signoff and explicit SLO droppoints in the tile.

emma.partners: Owners: Dmitri->HW; Claire->marketplace + embargo; Rick->devex + CI; Zara->ops playbook; Emma->press comms. Draft mapping by Thu EOD, cert artifacts by Mon.

dmitri-hw: Vendor contacts I have: nvidia:maria@nvidia, habana:raj@habana, amd:lucas@amd. Will DM intros and post summary.

claire.prod: I'll draft tile YAML with a fallback_guidance field and include recommended routing snippet for customers using Dedicated capacity.

rick-devex: I'll add a small example YAML and a PR template for CI jobs. Example tile snippet: {"sku":"rw-mi300-64g","quant":"q4_0","recommended_bs":1}

zara-oncall: Filed INFRA-5177 for lab image tag power-profile-v5 (needed for thermal repro).

emma.partners: Action items recap and owners posted. I'll schedule a 20-min sync Fri 11:00 to align on embargo windows and confirm vendor freeze dates. Please update the shared sheet under "HW-Roadmap-Waves".

vendor-bot: Reminder: vendor embargo policy checklist available at https://partners.redwood/embargo-checklist (auto-note).

dmitri-hw: Note: if the microcode lands after our freeze, we'll need a +72h cert window and an embargo extension.

claire.prod: Aiming to have the marketplace tile draft by Wed so legal can review Thu.

rick-devex: PR will include smoke thresholds and a minimal runbook for SIs.

zara-oncall: Ops playbook draft by Fri AM.

emma.partners: Thanks everyone 44d update the sheet and ping here with blockers.
